summary.rationale: Implementation follows the approved minimal mobile wireframe: aligned scale bands, equal measure widths, clear half-bar divisions, readable chord symbols and one transport with automatic repeat indicated. No additional theory or dashboard panels.

notes: Required ready/loading/buffering/paused/error/retry states are specified and verified or code-reviewed in verify.json.
One visible primary transport;44px minimum target exceeded. No destructive workflow.
No new semantic classes or global theme variables; existing semantic utilities visibly render borders, active contrast and typography.
320px ready screenshot fits complete chart and primary button without horizontal scroll; long scale and split symbols remain readable.
Measure numbers appear once and scale labels align to the relevant bars. Navigation safely wraps to two rows.
Error/retry evidence retains chart and reuses sole transport. Physical phone listening has not been tested; buffering was reviewed rather than forced by network throttling.
Musical measures and subdivisions determine hierarchy, with semantic contrast reserved for the sounding chord.
Compact spacing keeps a useful first viewport; no cards, decorative badges, motion noise or redundant Current/Next labels.
Songs score rendering is outside this review scope and remains unchanged.
Profile is recorded in design.json; implementation follows semantic theme-usage guidance without global token additions.

Local website workflow and design-rule-engine govern review. Unavailable optional Vercel design skills were not claimed or required; available implementation review guidance is recorded in build.json.

next_steps: Proceed with Code Critic and the approved GitHub/Vercel release workflow. Actual phone audio behavior remains a stated verification limit, not a release-blocking design defect.
